claude.sample_unit: survey respondents (BRFSS 2022 derivation; also BRFSS 2024 N=448,213, NHANES 2015-2018 N=10,775)

links.outcome: Model discrimination and calibration on temporally later and cross-domain external validation cohorts
links.effect: EBM AUC 0.8627, Brier 0.0845 on BRFSS 2024; calibrated AUC 0.7504, Brier 0.1358 on NHANES 2015-2018 (drop from derivation-era performance).
links.quote: The EBM achieved strong temporal stability on BRFSS 2024 (AUC: 0.8627; Brier Score: 0.0845).

unlisted_practices: Using intrinsically interpretable models (EBM) rather than black-box ensembles
Isotonic regression recalibration for domain shift

links.outcome: External temporal and cross-domain validation performance
links.effect: BRFSS 2024 AUC: 0.8627; Brier Score: 0.0845. NHANES AUC: 0.7504; Brier Score: 0.1358.
links.quote: The EBM achieved strong temporal stability on BRFSS 2024 (AUC: 0.8627; Brier Score: 0.0845).

links.effect: Zero-shot EBM AUC: 0.7591 versus black-box stacked meta-ensemble AUC: 0.7706.
links.quote: Notably, the zero-shot EBM (AUC: 0.7591) closely matched the predictive ceiling of a black-box stacked meta-ensemble (AUC: 0.7706), eliminating the need for unstable post-hoc approximations.

links.effect: Auditable shape functions revealed non-linear thresholds and pairwise interactions for age, smoking, income, and diabetes.
links.quote: Fully auditable shape functions explicitly revealed non-linear risk thresholds and synergistic pairwise interactions for key predictors including age, smoking, income, and diabetes.

unlisted_practices: Survey-weighted machine learning to account for complex survey designs
